lots.working: No same-item SOLD result within the last 24 months, so keep and flip are both 0. For reference only: the old sales imply about AUD 4-7.50 hammer per model, so 13 models about AUD 55-100 at auction.

lots.key_photo_findings: Captions legible on 10 cased models. Three bottom items are outer card boxes (Octopussy, Goldfinger, The Spy Who Loved Me) so their models are not seen. Mostly low-demand cars (Nova, Corvorado, Land Rover, XJ8, Thunderbird); no DB5. No magazines.

lots.question_for_gowans: Please confirm the three outer boxes (Octopussy, Goldfinger, Spy Who Loved Me) each contain the cased model, and whether any cases are cracked or models loose on their bases.

lots.guide_summary: Sum of the most recent dated eBay SOLD prices (via PriceCharting) for 8 identified carts is about AUD 81; the rest of the carts are unpriced upside, probably AUD 3-10 each. Asking side (eBay lot snippets, unverified) about AUD 100-150 for 20-cart lots. No unsold results. USD at 1.4375 AUD (open.er-api.com, 2026-10-01).
lots.working: Sum-of-parts from SOLD singles within 24 months (USD x 1.4375): Zippy Race 14.25 x 2 = 28.50, Mag Max 15.53, Ninja-kun 13.31, Hero Soukessen 13.20, Pennant Race 5.03, Gachapon Senshi 2 2.80, Family Stadium 87 2.86 = AUD 81.23 (counting Zippy Race twice; if only one copy, AUD 66.98). Keep: 81.23 / 1.198 = 67.80, rounded down to $65. Flip: 81.23 less about 15% eBay fees (12.18) less about $8 packaging (postage charged to buyers) = 61.05 / 2.396 = 25.48, rounded down to $25. This is an adaptation: the lot is not sold as one item, the singles are US eBay prices, and the second Zippy Race is not certain, so treat these caps as soft. The unpriced carts (Ikki, Puyan, Kitaro, Best Play II, side-on carts) are not counted.
lots.confidence_reason: Labels read clearly in the photos and several dated SOLD singles opened, but evidence is per-cart US eBay data, not a lot result, and the cart count and condition (untested) are uncertain.
lots.dropped_entries: Dropped the eBay AU AU$249.95 Famicom console plus 12 games bundle (includes a console, not like-for-like, snippet only). Replaced the PriceCharting aggregate guide figures (US$11.16, US$10.80, US$3.95) with the actual dated sales shown on those same pages and moved them to SOLD. eBay lot snippets kept only as unverified leads.
lots.key_photo_findings: Readable labels: irem Zippy Race IF-01, Banpresto BAP-X5 SD Hero Soukessen (1992), ASCII HSP-33 Best Play Pro Yakyuu II (1990), Sunsoft Ikki, Jaleco JF-03 Ninja-kun Majou no Bouken, Nichibutsu NBF-MM Mag Max, Namco Family Stadium 87, Puyan (HFC-PO), Bandai Gegege no Kitaro, Bandai SD Gundam Gachapon Senshi 2, Konami Ganbare Pennant Race 1989. Several carts only seen end-on. Nothing rare spotted.
lots.condition: Loose carts, yellowed shells, label scuffs and small tears (Kitaro label torn at corner), dirt on some. Untested. No boxes or manuals.
lots.question_for_gowans: How many cartridges are in the box in total, and are the 8 carts in photo 1 additional to the ones in the box? Any tested?
